hostOnlyBody: Hosts set up the meeting, its people and its sections. Ask one of them, or a workspace admin, to change something.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.hostLabelHint: A role or a first name, e.g. Scrum master, Facilitator, Julie. Shown everywhere in Ronde: “Notes · {host}”.
meeting.localeHint: Language of the reminder emails, the notifications and the generated minutes.

sections.title: Check-in sections
sections.name: Section name

achievement.label: Done
achievement.hint: What was done. Offers to tick off last time's plans.

plan.label: Planned
plan.hint: What comes next. Shown again at the next session and in the reminder.

blocker.label: Blocker
blocker.hint: What blocks. Highlighted on screen, can become a follow-up action, tracked in the stats.

custom.label: Custom
custom.hint: A free section, with no special behaviour.

sections.carryPlansHint: Everyone finds what they planned as boxes to tick as they go. A box left unticked doesn't count as done.
sections.carryPlans: Bring back what was in “{plan}” last time
sections.customPlaceholder: E.g. Research, Demo to show, Need help
sections.hint: Each role (done, planned, blocker, other) goes to one section at most. A section keeps what was entered when its name, role or input changes.

reminder.title: Check-in reminder
reminder.dayBefore: The working day before the meeting
reminder.sameDay: On the meeting day, before the time
reminder.emailHint: Only people whose check-in is not filled in yet get the reminder. You can unsubscribe someone with the “Reminder” box in the team list.
reminder.noSmtp: No mail server configured: set SMTP_URL in the container to turn email reminders on.
reminder.teamHint: A collective reminder in a team room is set up in “Notifications”.

warmUp.moodOffer: Offer everyone to share their mood of the day (anonymous)
warmUp.bankHint: A random question is drawn for each meeting; the control room can change it. Leave empty to turn the icebreaker off.

sources.turnOn: No integration is on for this meeting. Turn GitLab or GitHub on in “Modules” to import each person's issues and merge or pull requests.

hub.intro: The tools this meeting works with, and where each stands. Open a card to set it up.
hub.rulesOn: {count, plural, one {# rule on} other {# rules on}}
hub.gitlab: Issues and merge requests of each person in their check-in
hub.github: Issues and pull requests of the followed repositories
hub.wiki: Minutes published to the team's wiki
hub.calendar: Sessions in people's calendars, kept in sync
hub.notifications: Chat, email and text messages around the meeting

preview.frameTitle: Preview of the reminder email for {name}

token.saved: Saved · enter another one to replace it

gitlab.followed: {count, plural, one {# project or group followed} other {# projects or groups followed}}
gitlab.noFilter: No filter: all projects are followed
gitlab.saveForGroups: Save the settings to show the projects of the new groups.

people.title: People ({count})
people.intro: Profiles come from the workspace directory. The role sets what each person can do in this meeting.

roleHints.host: Runs the sessions from the control room, sets up the meeting and publishes its minutes
roleHints.cohost: Runs the sessions from the control room, without changing the settings
roleHints.participant: Fills in a check-in before each session and takes a turn in the round table
roleHints.observer: Follows the sessions live and reads the minutes, with no check-in and no turn

people.nobodyLeft: Everyone in the directory already takes part.
people.categoriesHint: Teams, birthdays and names are edited in the workspace directory.

template.title: Reuse this format
template.intro: Start other meetings from this one: the template is offered when creating a meeting in the workspace.

items.people: {count, plural, one {# person and their roles} other {# people and their roles}}

counts.modules: {count, plural, one {# module on} other {# modules on}}

template.name: Template name
template.saved: Template saved: it is offered when creating a meeting.

navHints.general: Name, mark, format and timer of the meeting.
navHints.schedule: When the sessions take place, and their exceptions.
navHints.people: Who takes part, and what each one may do.
navHints.sections: What everyone fills in before the meeting.
navHints.agenda: The order of the meeting, block by block.
navHints.projects: The projects followed, each with its round.
navHints.modules: Facilitation, formats and tools, turned on as needed.
navHints.appearance: Colour of the meeting on every screen.
navHints.notifications: Reminders and messages sent around the meeting.
navHints.integrations: Video call, issue trackers and wiki.
navHints.template: Save this meeting as a template of the workspace.
navHints.danger: What cannot be undone: leave, end or delete.

status.invalid: Not saved: check the highlighted fields.
status.failed: Not saved: the change was refused.

appearance.accentHint: Used for the buttons, the timer and the shared screen of this meeting, in light and dark themes.
appearance.themeHint: Light or dark theme is a personal choice:

danger.title: Delete the meeting
danger.hint: The meeting leaves every list and its pages close for everyone. Its history is kept with the workspace.

video.title: Video call

providers.link: A link to any tool (Meet, Zoom, Teams…)
providers.jitsi: Jitsi Meet (a room created for this meeting)

video.linkHint: Shown at the top of every page and in the emails.
video.jitsiHint: Empty: meet.jit.si. The room name is drawn once, hard to guess, and stays the same for every session.
video.ownServer: A server of this meeting's own
video.serverHint: The workspace's servers are added by its administrators, in the workspace settings.
video.bbbHint: Ronde opens the room when someone joins and brings each person in with their name; hosts join as moderators. The secret is encrypted and never shown again.
video.roomCreated: Room created: the link is saved.

logoHint: The workspace logo shows on the shared screen, in emails and minutes.
logoLink: Change it in the workspace settings

icon.title: Icon
icon.hint: Shown next to the meeting's name in the menus and lists: an emoji, or its own image (a logo, a team photo).
icon.imageFirst: The image is shown instead of the emoji; remove it to see the emoji again.
icon.notSaved: The image could not be saved.
